environment: local isolated docker-compose (MySQL oneapi, redis, mock upstreams); no production data or traffic
scope: fault matrix F7-F18 (F17 partial); F19/F20/F22 recorded separately in data-flow-failover-isolated-2026-09-22.json

scenarios.procedure: billing stopped; reservation(reserved)+settlement task(pending) seeded directly; billing started; then restarted again
scenarios.evidence: recovery worker settled exactly once: reservation committed, one consume ledger (-10), task completed, attempts=0->completed; second restart produced no new ledger and no balance change (CAS idempotency)
scenarios.note: direct DB seeding froze 1000 without prior deduction, so net balance moved +990 (1000 released - 10 charged) — arithmetic consistent with seeded state

scenarios.procedure: ConsumeTokenQuota(amount=50, reservation_id=R) via gRPC: first call, then two replays with same R, then a new reservation
scenarios.defect: dedupe claim used OnConflict(DoNothing)+RowsAffected; on MySQL a duplicate reports RowsAffected!=0, sending replays into the deduction branch which crashed on a keyless claim UPDATE (ErrMissingWhereClause 'WHERE conditions required'). Rollback prevented double-charging but replay returned an internal error instead of the recorded result
scenarios.fix: 5125ac9e read-then-insert under row lock; replay returns recorded remaining=750, no re-deduction; new reservation deducts normally
scenarios.post_fix_evidence: first: remaining 750; replay x2: remaining 750 (success); tokens.remain_quota=750

scenarios.procedure: mock-slow prompt (8s upstream delay); billing stopped mid-flight; request completed upstream but commit RPC failed
scenarios.evidence: client 502; no upstream replay (single reservation); reservation stuck reserved -> expired_at forced past -> sweeper released: status expired, refund +1006, zero consume rows, balance restored
scenarios.gap_fixed: post-forward commit RPC failure produced no log at any level; added WARN with reservation_id (8926b5e5)

scenarios.procedure: EVENT_BUS_BACKEND=redis-streams on channel-service; message injected and forced into PEL via rogue XREADGROUP while consumer stopped; consumer restarted; then malformed payload injected
scenarios.evidence: valid pending message reclaimed by claimLoop (idle 30s + tick 10s) after restart, processed idempotently, ACKed (XPENDING 1->0)
gaps: malformed/unmarshallable payload is never ACKed and has no delivery cap or DLQ — poison messages loop through reclaim forever (design decision pending)
failures were printf-only; added micro_one_api_events_stream_failures_total{topic,reason} (04382c4c), verified incrementing on poison messages; test messages manually XACKed at cleanup

scenarios.procedure: webhook notification to always-500 endpoint; webhook notification to 200+{"errcode":87005} endpoint
scenarios.evidence: both: pending(retry_count 1) -> failed(retry_count 2), last_error recorded ('webhook returned status 500' / 'webhook rejected notification: errcode=87005'), sent_at=0 (never marked sent); no separate 'retry' status — pending+retry_count carries that meaning
scenarios.note: terminal failure at retry_count=2 with default max 3: boundary semantics (attempt count vs retry count) should be documented; lease CAS (ClaimPending/CompleteProcessing) prevents concurrent sends

scenarios.procedure: RecordModelUsage gRPC: success sample, error sample, unregistered model
scenarios.evidence: registered model: request_count=2, error_count=1, avg_latency=75=(100+50)/2 (weighted by sample count); storage errors propagate to caller by design
scenarios.gap_fixed: unregistered model returned success=true with no row written (deliberate best-effort drop, but invisible); added micro_one_api_channel_model_usage_dropped_total{reason=unregistered_model} (ad353c0c)

scenarios.procedure: SetConfig twice then GetConfig via config-service gRPC
scenarios.evidence: revisions 1 -> 2, write responses return revision, GetConfig reads back persisted revision 2; config-service only promises the persisted version (config.changed has no consumer — documented boundary, not treated as applied-to-runtime)

scenarios.procedure: pending alipay order seeded directly; observed payment reconcile job (1min interval)
scenarios.evidence: query failure visible: WARN 'payment provider status queries failed' scanned=1 query_failures=1; order stays pending (no false paid/closed)
scenarios.blocked_parts: lost-callback convergence (query->paid), duplicate callback, and issuance failure need an Alipay sandbox round-trip or a mock provider with QueryOrder — not executable against the built-in mock channel (never queried by design). Remains 待验收 for those sub-cases

scenarios.procedure: oauth account (kimi) with expired access token; mock rotating token endpoint (each refresh token valid once); MySQL trigger blocks UPDATE on subscription_accounts; relay restarts to clear token cache
evidence: baseline: refresh via mock (refresh_calls 1, rt rotated), new creds persisted encrypted, request 200

persist blocked: refresh succeeds (calls 2), persist fails after 3 backoff attempts (100/200ms), request still 200 with rotated token, WARN log + micro_one_api_credential_persist_failures_total +1, DB unchanged (stale rt)
same-process second request: cached rotated creds reused, no new refresh (calls stay 2), 200 — old refresh token NOT reused
relay restart: refresh task sweeps expired account with stale rotated rt -> invalid_grant, classified non-retryable (stops retrying), WARN logged; request path served by persisted access token
defects_fixed: f37aaa4e: KIMI_TOKEN_REFRESH_URL/CLIENT_ID config overrides were applied AFTER NewKimiTokenProvider captured the defaults — overrides silently ignored (init-order bug, prod-affecting)
f92417eb: persist failure was log-only; added credential_persist_failures_total{platform} metric
notes: OAuth account with non-empty access_token is used as-is regardless of expires_at (refresh only when access_token empty) — documented behavior to be aware of
refresh_task hook error text says 'token refresh failed' when the persist layer actually failed — wording could be clearer (minor)
